Ayesha — great to hear. I attached a compact pricing matrix that maps three Optimize credit tiers to expected percent reductions in per-token spend assuming typical batching/caching and a conservative quantization profile. Quick highlights below: 

- Efficiency Credits: purchased credits are applied as a monthly multiplier to the per-token bill for requests routed through Optimize tooling (batching + prefix cache). Example: 100k credits -> ~12% cost reduction baseline; 500k credits -> ~28%.
- Quantization guidance: for 8k sequence models we recommend FP16->INT8 dynamic quantization for inference on A100-optimized pools; if you need max latency predictability we have an INT8+KV-cache profile that retains end-to-end p95 within 10% of FP16.
- Implementation: Minimal code changes (flag in SDK) and we can auto-apply per-route policies in your account.

I'm proposing a pilot package: 3 months, 250k Optimize credits, onboarding support, and a 10% pilot discount off the total committed spend. If that looks reasonable I can draft the commercial term sheet and loop in our sales ops.

Attachments: 20260901_Redwood_Pricing_Matrix.xlsx (pricing matrix, sample ROI calc)

Cheers,
Olga Petrov

Olga — jumping in with a commercial suggestion before you send the term sheet. Two levers we've had success with: 1) staggered credit usage tiers (volume discounts that kick in at monthly redemption thresholds) and 2) fixed per-month committed credits with a conversion-rate guarantee for batchable traffic. Proposed sketch for NovusAI: 

- Pilot: 3 months, 250k credits, 10% pilot discount (as you suggested).
- Post-pilot committed package: 12-month agreement, 1.5M credits/year (125k/mo) with tiered top-ups: once monthly redeemed credits >150k -> additional 8% discount; >250k -> additional 15% discount.
- One-time onboarding fee waived if they sign within 30 days of pilot end.

On the quantization side: recommend committing to an INT8+latency-SLA variant only for background embedding and re-rank routes, keep chat LLM route on FP16 for first 6 months. That mix preserves UX and maximizes ROI.

If you want, I can run a quick modeled cost comparison for the proposed structure and embed it in the term sheet.

—Ben
